relationships.evidence_quote: exerts its biological effects primarily through high-affinity binding to the tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB)

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF has been shown to downregulate the expression and activity of the potassium-chloride co-transporter 2 (KCC2)

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF-TrkB signaling enhances NMDA receptor phosphorylation and trafficking to the synaptic membrane

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: drives downstream MyD88/NF-κB signaling, leading to cytokine production and sustained inflammation

relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: are crucial for microglial proliferation and inflammasome activation, facilitating the release of IL-1β via NLRP3 signaling pathways

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP increases vascular permeability and sensitizes nociceptors by lowering their activation threshold

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: monoclonal antibodies targeting either the CGRP ligand (e.g., fremanezumab, galcanezumab, eptinezumab)

key_findings: Narrative review: BDNF-TrkB signaling potentiates NMDA receptors and downregulates KCC2, producing GABAergic disinhibition in dorsal horn.
CGRP and substance P drive neurogenic inflammation and peripheral sensitization; anti-CGRP antibodies such as galcanezumab are effective in migraine.
